conceptZh: 玩具戰士拿盾牌推倒一排積木，兩塊剛好疊成「力」和「口」，連鎖倒下。
object: toy warrior with foam sword and shield, domino-like blocks
morph: blocks tumble into 力 on the left and 口 on the right
creativeAngle: 大膽的主角一擊推倒，連鎖落位。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a sunrise-orange stage with a cream floor; the glyph is solid cobalt-blue 加: 力 left, 口 right. A chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield strides in, boasting. The Traditional Chinese glyph 加 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the warrior points his sword dramatically at a row of standing blocks and bumps the first with his shield; the first 加 is spoken as it tips. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the blocks topple domino-style, flip and slide, landing as 力 with its hooked stroke and a square 口 beside it; the second 加 is spoken at the last click; the warrior spins in surprise. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a toy fuel pump on a tiny stand rolls in, and the warrior pretends to pump it with a cheer; 加油 is spoken as a small drop of oil gleams. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 加 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the warrior raises his sword and bounces; the glyph is still. Audio: one warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in Taiwan-standard Mandarin, reading exactly these syllables with clear tones and no erhua: 「加、加、加油」 (ㄐㄧㄚ、ㄐㄧㄚ、ㄐㄧㄚ ㄧㄡˊ). Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.4s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only wooden clacks and a springy boing, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
